messages.text: How do I get access to the staging database? I need to debug a tenant config issue.
Request the staging-readonly group in Opal, your team lead approves it. Then kestrel-ctl db connect staging. Access expires after 14 days so you will need to re-request.
The query-engine test test_rollup_window is flaky again. It fails when the test runner crosses a UTC midnight boundary. Workaround: run with FREEZE_TIME=1 until PR #2291 lands.
